name: Atlantic City & Cape May
summary: The original boardwalk and casino town, then Victorian Cape May — the oldest seaside resort in America — at the state's southern tip.

lodging.name: A Cape May Victorian B&B
lodging.blurb: Gingerbread guesthouses steps from the beach and the mall.

foodMustTry.name: Saltwater taffy & Jersey Shore pizza
foodMustTry.blurb: Boardwalk taffy is an Atlantic City invention.

days.label: Day 99 — Atlantic City
days.summary: The boardwalk that named the Monopoly squares.

item.title: Atlantic City Boardwalk & Steel Pier
item.blurb: The world's first boardwalk (1870), the casinos, and the amusement rides of Steel Pier.

item.title: Lucy the Elephant
item.blurb: A six-story elephant-shaped building from 1881 — one of the great pieces of American roadside architecture.

days.label: Day 100 — Cape May
days.summary: Victorian gingerbread at the Jersey Cape.

item.title: Cape May Victorian district & the mall

location.name: Washington Street Mall, Cape May
location.address: Washington St Mall, Cape May, NJ

item.blurb: Hundreds of candy-colored Victorian houses, a pedestrian shopping mall, and the oldest seaside resort in the country.

item.title: Cape May Lighthouse & Point

location.name: Cape May Lighthouse
location.address: 215 Lighthouse Ave, Cape May Point, NJ

item.blurb: Climb the 1859 light and watch for migrating birds at the point.

days.summary: Up to the birthplace of the nation.
